Housing costs
28. When considering whether a non-dependant deduction should be made from allowable housing
costs, SADLA is added to the list of benefits awarded to


      1. the claimant or


      2. their partner1.


                                                                                    1 ESA Regs, Sch 6, 19(6)


29. When calculating a non-dependant’s gross weekly income, SADLA is added to the list of benefits that

are disregarded1.


                                                                               1 ESA Regs, Sch 6, para 19(8)




STATE PENSION CREDIT

Additional amount for the severely disabled
30. An award of SPC may include an additional amount for persons who are severely disabled. SADLA is
added to the list of qualifying benefits when considering whether the claimant or, if applicable, any

partner, is severely disabled.1


                                                                            1 SPC Regs, Sch 1 para (1) and (2)




31. When considering whether members of a polygamous marriage are entitled to an additional amount
for persons who are severely disabled, SADLA is added to the list of qualifying benefits when considering

whether a claimant, any partner and any additional spouse is severely disabled. 1


                                                                                 1 SPC Regs, Sch 3 para 1(9)


Housing costs
32. For the purposes of calculating housing costs, a non-dependant deduction should not be made where

the claimant or a partner is in receipt of the care component of SADLA 1.


                                                                               1 SPC Regs, Sch 2 para 14(6)


33. When calculating a non-dependent’s gross weekly income, SADLA is added to the list of benefits

that are disregarded1.
